questions.question: Whose creation does Maitreya describe in this chapter as the reservoir of all Vedic knowledge?
questions.explanation: "Now you can hear from me about the creation of Brahma, the reservoir of all Vedic knowledge." (SB 3.12.1)

questions.question: What did Brahma first create at the beginning?

options.text: The nescient engagements like self-deception and anger

questions.explanation: "Brahma first created the nescient engagements like self-deception, the sense of death, anger after frustration, the sense of false ownership, and the illusory bodily conception..." (SB 3.12.2)

questions.question: What were the names of the four great sages Brahma created in the beginning?
questions.explanation: "In the beginning, Brahma created four great sages named Sanaka, Sananda, Sanatana and Sanat-kumara." (SB 3.12.4)

questions.question: Why did the four Kumaras refuse Brahma's order to generate progeny?

options.text: Being attached to Vasudeva, they aimed at liberation

questions.explanation: "But due to their being attached to Vasudeva, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, they aimed at liberation, and therefore they expressed their unwillingness." (SB 3.12.5)

questions.question: From where did the blue and red child generated from Brahma's anger come out?
questions.explanation: "Although he tried to curb his anger, it came out from between his eyebrows, and a child mixed blue and red was immediately generated." (SB 3.12.7)

questions.question: By what name did Brahma say the crying boy would be called by all people?
questions.explanation: "...you shall be called by the name Rudra by all people because you have so anxiously cried." (SB 3.12.10)

questions.question: Besides Rudra, how many other names did Brahma give to the boy?
questions.explanation: "My dear boy Rudra, you have eleven other names: Manyu, Manu, Mahinasa, Mahan, Siva, Rtadhvaja, Ugrareta, Bhava, Kala, Vamadeva and Dhrtavrata." (SB 3.12.12)

questions.question: How many wives, called the Rudranis, did Rudra have?
questions.explanation: "O Rudra, you also have eleven wives, called the Rudranis..." (SB 3.12.13)

questions.question: Why did Brahma become afraid when Rudra's offspring assembled together?

options.text: They attempted to devour the entire universe

questions.explanation: "...when they assembled together they attempted to devour the entire universe. When Brahma, the father of the living entities, saw this, he became afraid of the situation." (SB 3.12.16)

questions.question: After being ordered by Brahma to perform penance, what did Rudra do?

options.text: He entered the forest to perform austere penances
He went to the heavenly planets

questions.explanation: "Addressing him with words of assent, he entered the forest to perform austere penances." (SB 3.12.20)

questions.question: How many sons did Brahma beget for the extension of the generations?
questions.explanation: "...thought of generating living entities and begot ten sons for the extension of the generations." (SB 3.12.21)

questions.question: From which part of Brahma was Narada born?
questions.explanation: "Narada was born from the deliberation of Brahma, which is the best part of the body." (SB 3.12.23)

questions.question: From which part of Brahma was religion manifested?
questions.explanation: "Religion was manifested from the breast of Brahma, wherein is seated the Supreme Personality of Godhead Narayana..." (SB 3.12.25)

questions.question: Sage Kardama, husband of Devahuti, was manifested from what?
questions.explanation: "Sage Kardama, husband of the great Devahuti, was manifested from the shadow of Brahma." (SB 3.12.27)

questions.question: What was the name of Brahma's daughter who attracted his mind toward sex?
questions.explanation: "...we have heard that Brahma had a daughter named Vak who was born from his body and who attracted his mind toward sex..." (SB 3.12.28)

questions.question: After the sages rebuked him, what did the ashamed Brahma do with the body he had accepted?

options.text: He at once gave it up

questions.explanation: "...became very much ashamed and at once gave up the body he had accepted." (SB 3.12.33)

questions.question: When Brahma was thinking of how to create the worlds, what became manifested from his four mouths?
questions.explanation: "...the four Vedas, which contain all varieties of knowledge, became manifested from his four mouths." (SB 3.12.34)

questions.question: Beginning from which face of Brahma did the four Vedas gradually become manifest?
questions.explanation: "Beginning from the front face of Brahma, gradually the four Vedas — Rk, Yajur, Sama and Atharva — became manifest." (SB 3.12.37)

questions.question: From which mouth of Brahma did the different varieties of fire sacrifices become manifested?
questions.explanation: "All the different varieties of fire sacrifices...became manifested from the eastern mouth of Brahma." (SB 3.12.40)

questions.question: The male and female forms generated from Brahma's body became known as Manu Svayambhuva and which queen?
questions.explanation: "...the one who had the male form became known as the Manu named Svayambhuva, and the woman became known as Satarupa, the queen of the great soul Manu." (SB 3.12.54)

questions.question: How many children did Manu beget in Satarupa?
questions.explanation: "...he [Manu] begot in Satarupa five children — two sons, Priyavrata and Uttanapada, and three daughters, Akuti, Devahuti and Prasuti." (SB 3.12.56)
